linkedin:
A Lovable app is a static React/Vite bundle plus a Supabase backend.

Host the built frontend on free static hosting with SSL, then point it at a Supabase you control. Keep managed Supabase, or move the data into a managed Postgres. Set your `VITE_` variables before you build, and never put the Supabase `service_role` key in frontend env.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/deploy-lovable-app-to-your-own-server/
